title: Organizations created in the app have no AWS home, so they can never get a computer on development
description: Only the members CLI seed path gives an organization the deployment account as its AWS home (anthus-managed). An organization created through the app starts with awsAccountId null (pending provisioning) and every computer start is refused. On 2026-10-10 the user's own organization was fixed by running members seed for it (tenant 919259eb, owner ryan@anth.us). Decide the product path for Anthus-managed organizations on a hosted environment: set the deployment account at creation for Anthus-managed setup, or require explicit provisioning and tell the user in the chat. Related to the customer-account provisioning work (PR 432).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root cause: the enable-time home rule from PR 494 already homes unchosen organizations in the deployment account. Organizations enabled before it hold no home and no setup path and are refused with no_aws_home. Fix in PR 544: shared rule helpers, an idempotent migrate-organization-aws-home script that is a dry run unless --execute, and Gherkin for the migration and for app-created to first computer start. Home is assigned at enable not at creation because the owner may choose the customer-account path while pending. Open product question: should open-signup development auto-enable new organizations.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Resolved (PR 544, merged). Root cause: the rule that homes an organization in the deployment account already existed (PR 494, 2026-10-10) and applies when an operator enables or reinstates it; organizations enabled BEFORE that rule kept a null home. PR 544 adds an idempotent migration (conversation/bin/migrate-organization-aws-home.ts, dry run by default) and a scenario showing a created-then-enabled organization starts its computer. Dry run against development on 2026-10-14: no enabled organization without an AWS home, so nothing needed migrating and --execute was not run. Open product questions for the owner: should open-signup development auto-enable new organizations, and should suspended organizations without a home be migrated now.

right_now_summary: PR 544 merged; existing homes are covered, but auto-enable and suspended-organization migration still need decisions.
